CheckingMessage: This till asks the cloud whether an online menu follows this branch. It takes a few seconds after the till starts.
DeleteSectionMessage: The section and what it shows leave the online menu. The products themselves are not changed.
EmptySectionMessage: Add whole categories or single products. A whole category also brings the products you add to it later.
Lead: Arrange what customers see on your online menu. Sections are the menu's own headings (Breakfast, Today's specials), separate from product categories. Prices and names always come from your products.
NoSectionsYetMessage: Until you add a section, the online menu shows every active product, grouped by category. Add sections to choose exactly what customers see and in what order.
NotConnected: This till is not connected to Coduo POS Online
NotConnectedMessage: You can arrange the menu now. It goes online once the till is connected in Settings > Online.
NotLinked: No online menu follows this branch yet
NotLinkedMessage: Open the menu editor, choose "From my POS" and pick this branch. Your sections then appear there within a minute.
SectionNameHint: What customers read as the heading, for example Breakfast or Hot drinks.
SendingSoon: Sending your products within a minute
SingleProductsHelp: Pick products one by one. A product picked here shows here even if its category is in another section.
SomethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
SwitchedOff: Switched off: not shown until it is active again
WholeCategoriesHelp: Every active product in the category shows here, including ones you add later.
